environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door Premium. The Front Door instance has a WAF policy in Prevention mode with Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet 2.1 and Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet 1.0. Additionally, the application's _Layout.cshtml and all view templates enforce script loading exclusively through a custom TagHelper (IntegrityScriptTagHelper) that computes SHA-384 hashes at build time from a manifest file (sri-manifest.json) generated during CI/CD pipeline. Scripts not present in the manifest are rendered with an invalid integrity attribute (integrity="sha384-BLOCKED") causing the browser to refuse loading. The Content-Security-Policy response header is set via middleware: script-src 'self' 'strict-dynamic'; require-sri-for script; with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The /uploads/ path is served with Content-Disposition: attachment header via custom StaticFileOptions ResponseHeaders callback, preventing inline execution when directly navigated.

config.front_door: Azure Front Door Premium with WAF Policy in Prevention mode
config.sri_enforcement: IntegrityScriptTagHelper with SHA-384 from build-time sri-manifest.json; unmanifested scripts get integrity=sha384-BLOCKED
